primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: EASI measures the extent and severity of atopic eczema based on assessments of 4 body regions: head/neck, trunk, upper limbs and lower limbs. For each region the percentage of skin affected and the severity (scored as none \[0\], mild \[1\], moderate \[2\], or severe \[3\]) for symptoms such as redness (erythema), thickness (induration, papulation, and edema), scratching (excoriation), and lichenification (lined skin) are assessed. Total score is calculated by summing the EASI scores of 6 symptoms across 4 body regions. The EASI score ranges from 0 (no disease) to 72 (worse disease).
